name: Single Leg Press
summary: One foot on the footbar, the other leg in tabletop. Builds even leg strength and pelvic control.
steps: Lie on the back with one heel on the footbar in line with the hip.
Lift the other leg to tabletop, knee over hip.
Breathe out to press out until the leg is straight; breathe in to bend.

layers.title: Single-leg heel raise
layers.text: Leg long, lower and lift the heel.

modifications: Heel on the bar for ankle or knee trouble.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.
Heel on the bar, smaller bend.
Keep the load light or go back to two legs.

cues:
Both hip bones stay level.
The tabletop knee stays over its hip.
Soft knee at the top.
No momentum.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
